result.brief: 提出免训练的重叠分块 ViT 解码加速方法，通过跨块共享注意力外的逐 token 计算并保留少量逐块层，在视频解码器与图像自编码器上实现 1.4-1.8 倍加速且质量持平。
result.reason: Training-free acceleration of overlapping-tiled ViT decoders/autoencoders (MiniMax-H3 video decoder, ViTok-v2 image autoencoder), sharing per-token computation across tiles; directly touches visual autoencoder decoding efficiency.
